'''Trenwyth''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Trenwyth system/Legends|Trenwyth system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Uninhabited until [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the [[Nagai–Tof War]] Trenwyth was settled by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]], after the establishment of their base on [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]]. The planet was later [[Battle of Trenwyth|settled]] by the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]]. While ''en route'' to [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Bahb]], [[Marruc]], [[Jahn]], and [[Rahuhl]] encountered the injured Nagai [[Taikotelai Akikoma|Tai]] on Trenwyth. Leia healed him of his wounds.
